title: ODOC-437 slice 3: reshape the four role profiles to measure and report the context budgets (AC3)
description:
ODOC-437 slice 3. Advances AC3.

RESHAPE the four existing role profiles -- implementation, review, verification, documentation -- and do NOT add a new kind: opum-cli maps phase to exactly those four, so a new kind would break that mapping (leader ruling Q1).

The budgets are TARGETS the profile declares and the compiler MEASURES and REPORTS; they are NOT hard ceilings enforced before a request. The spec calls them design defaults and requires the lore chars/4 figure to be LABELLED an estimate, with provider-reported usage recorded separately. An overrun names the content that required it.

DISCREPANCY TO RESOLVE AT DISPATCH (raised, not settled locally): ODOC-437 AC3 names 8k authored bootstrap / 16k task evidence / 2k result summaries, while the spec budget table gives <=3k always-loaded policy+role, <=2k task contract, 3-6k task Lore evidence, ~1k initial code map, and a 10-15k TOTAL startup target. State which governs and why.

Today implementation.toml declares max_tokens = 108000 over 14 sources, so this is a real reshape. Depends on Slices 1-2.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The four role profiles (implementation, review, verification, documentation) declare the measured targets; the compiler measures and reports them -- no new profile kind.
Actual provider input is reported separately from the estimator, and the chars/4 figure is labelled an estimate.
An overrun names the content that required it.

plan: Declare the four budget targets in .lore/agents/{implementation,review,verification,documentation}.toml and extend the profile schema (src/core/agent-profile.ts) to parse and validate them -- no new profile kind.

Measure the compiled pack parts against the declared targets in the compiler (src/core/agent-context.ts) and report them: label the chars/4 figure an estimate, name the overrunning content, and carry provider-reported usage separately from the estimator.
Update docs: docs/specs/agent-profile-context-retrieval.md, cli-contract section 5.6, and an ADR recording the class-to-pack-part mapping and citing MDL-7 / ODOC-437.
Prove both ways: a pack within target reports it, and an overrun names the content; bun test and bun run lore check green.
implementationNotes: DISPATCH RESOLUTION (team-lead, 2026-10-14): the two budget tables do not conflict. MDL-7 (opum-doc docs/standards/model-routing-and-cost.md; verified by ref, not relayed) rules the spec table (<=3k always-loaded policy+role, <=2k task contract, 3-6k task Lore evidence, ~1k code map, 10-15k total startup) is the TARGETS the profiles declare and the compiler reports against, while ODOC-437 AC3 (<=8k authored bootstrap, 16k task evidence) is the hard acceptance CEILING where an overrun is a failure naming its content. MDL-7 also requires the chars/4 figure be LABELLED an estimate and provider-reported usage recorded separately. Mapping (stated by the implementer, per the task): policy+role -> profile pinned tier + fixed overhead; task contract -> the --task-contract block; task evidence -> ranked sections; code map -> not produced by lore (reported N/A); total -> the whole pack, with harness/tools outside what lore can measure.
